title: US counties with high-incidence Lyme risk

source.name: Lyme disease high-incidence county classification
source.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

notes: CDC classifies a county as high-incidence when its Lyme case rate is at least twice the national average. That list held 29 counties three decades ago, grew to 130 a decade later, and now stands at roughly 260 -- concentrated in the Northeast and upper Midwest but expanding into the mid-Atlantic and parts of the West.
